class.name: SimpleTerrainData
class.brief_description: Tile height field resource used by [SimpleTerrain3D].
class.description:
[SimpleTerrainData] stores tile-based terrain height fields. Each entry in [member created_tile_cells] owns the [PackedFloat32Array] at the same index in [member tile_height_data]. Tile height arrays are row-major and contain [code](tile_size + 1) * (tile_size + 1)[/code] values. This resource is registered through ClassDB and can be created or modified from scripts. Assign it to [member SimpleTerrain3D.simple_terrain_data] to render and edit the stored tiles. [codeblock] var data := SimpleTerrainData.new() data.tile_size = 128 data.cell_size = 1.0 data.create_tile(Vector2i.ZERO) data.set_tile_height(Vector2i.ZERO, 64, 64, 4.0)
var terrain := SimpleTerrain3D.new() terrain.simple_terrain_data = data terrain.rebuild_mesh() add_child(terrain) [/codeblock]

method.name: create_tile
method.description: Creates a tile at [param cell] if one does not already exist. The new tile receives flat height data sized to [member tile_size].

method.name: fill_flat
method.description: Fills every existing tile with [param height] and emits a resource change notification. This does not create new tiles.

method.name: get_tile_height
method.description: Returns the height at tile-local vertex coordinate [param x], [param z] in [param cell].

method.name: get_tile_height_data
method.description: Returns the flat height array for [param cell], or an empty array if the tile does not exist.

method.name: get_tile_height_index
method.description: Returns the flat array index in a tile height array for tile-local vertex coordinate [param x], [param z].

method.name: get_tile_vertex_count
method.description: Returns the number of vertices per tile axis. This is always [member tile_size] + [code]1[/code].

method.name: has_tile
method.description: Returns whether tile [param cell] exists in [member created_tile_cells].

method.name: remove_tile
method.description: Removes tile [param cell] and its matching height data if it exists.

method.name: set_tile_height
method.description: Sets the height at tile-local vertex coordinate [param x], [param z] in [param cell] and emits a resource change notification.

method.name: set_tile_height_data
method.description: Sets the flat height array for [param cell]. The array is resized to [code](tile_size + 1) * (tile_size + 1)[/code].

members.member: World-space distance between neighboring terrain vertices.
Tile coordinates that have authored height data. Each entry corresponds to the same index in [member tile_height_data].
Array of [PackedFloat32Array] tile height fields. Each entry is stored row-major and should contain [code](tile_size + 1) * (tile_size + 1)[/code] values.
Number of terrain quads per tile axis. A value of [code]128[/code] means each tile stores [code]129 * 129[/code] height values.
